5095393384047.sourceDescription:
This artificial Christmas tree features a realistic design crafted from durable PE and PVC materials for safe, long-term family use. The combination of two different leaf shapes creates natural shades of gradation, providing a dense and authentic appearance that enhances any festive setting.

The hinged structure allows for quick and easy assembly, as branches automatically drop into place to save time and energy during setup. A folding metal stand supports the tree, ensuring high stability and preventing tipping while you arrange decorations and enjoy the holiday season with peace of mind.

Equipped with 350 bright LED lights, this pre-decorated tree offers eleven dynamic effects including steady on, quick flash, and slow fade. These lighting options create an eye-catching festival decoration that brings a romantic vibe to your home, transforming your living space into a warm and inviting environment.

The lush appearance is enhanced by 899 branch tips, thirty-five plump pine cones, and clusters of red berries scattered throughout the foliage. Snowy designs on the tips add a wintry touch, while the full-bodied shape ensures the tree looks attractive and elegant, serving as a stunning centerpiece for your holiday celebrations.

Measuring 180cm in height with a base width of 115cm, this green tree fits comfortably in most living rooms and reception areas. Its compact folded dimensions of 55cm by 55cm by 50cm make storage convenient when not in use, allowing you to reuse it year after year without taking up excessive space.
Hinged design allows branches to automatically drop into place for quick and easy assembly.
Comes pre-decorated with 350 LED lights featuring 11 dynamic effects for instant festive ambiance.
Durable PE and PVC construction ensures a realistic, dense appearance safe for long-term family use.
Folding metal stand provides high stability while compact folded dimensions enable convenient storage.
Guarantee - 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Hinged
Assembly required
With stand

5095393383347.sourceDescription:
This indoor Christmas tree is an eye-catching addition to any home decor during the festive holiday season. It provides a vibrant green focal point that enhances the atmosphere of your living space. The artificial design ensures lasting beauty without the need for daily watering or maintenance routines.

Branches are crafted with realistic tips to create the illusion of a genuine pine tree throughout the display. This detailed construction allows ornaments and lights to hang securely while maintaining a natural appearance. The dense foliage offers ample coverage for a full and lush visual effect.

A sturdy metal tree base provides stability to keep your trees standing tall and secure in place. This robust foundation prevents tipping and supports the weight of decorations effectively. The reliable stand ensures safety for households with children or pets moving around the area.

Quick assembly, disassembly and storage features make this product convenient for annual seasonal use. Users can easily set up the tree structure without complex tools or lengthy preparation times. Efficient packing allows for compact storage when the holidays conclude until next year arrives.

Only the tree with the stand is included as part of the complete package provided to customers. Ornaments are not included and are used just for effect to demonstrate potential styling options. In order to get a full appearance, please spread out all individual tips to get the best possible look from the tree.
Realistic branch tips create a natural pine appearance for festive home decor.
Sturdy metal base provides stability and prevents tipping during use.
Quick assembly and compact storage make seasonal setup convenient.
Dense foliage offers full coverage for hanging ornaments and lights.
Guarantee - 1 month
Artificial christmas tree type: Hooked
Assembly required
With stand

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture

Style around the occasion

Plan the display

Easy setup and storage: Designed with an integrated construction, this Christmas tree requires no trunk assembly. 5056214088247.sourceDescription:
Bring a cosy festive glow to smaller indoor spaces with this 40cm InLit Sparkly Artificial Fir Tree, a compact pre-lit Christmas decoration for shelves, sideboards, windowsills and corners.

At 45cm tall, it is easy to place around the home but still has enough height to feel like a proper little Christmas feature. Use it where a full-sized tree would be too large, or add it alongside your main tree to build a warmer, more complete festive display.

The tree is pre-lit with warm white LEDs, giving an instant seasonal glow without needing to add separate lights. Its natural-look green branches create the effect of a miniature fir tree, making it a more traditional and realistic choice than a flat light-up ornament.

Display it on a hallway table to welcome guests, place it on a sideboard for evening warmth, brighten a kitchen windowsill, or use it in a bedroom, conservatory or smaller living room.

The built-in auto on/off timer makes it easier to enjoy through the season, reducing the need for constant daily switching. Designed for indoor use only.

Supplied as an indoor InLit Sparkly Artificial Fir Tree, 40cm tall, with warm white LEDs and built-in timer, ready to display. Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included)
COMPACT FESTIVE FEATURE: This 40cm pre-lit artificial fir tree brings instant Christmas atmosphere to shelves, sideboards, windowsills, hallway tables and smaller indoor spaces. It is easy to position around the home, yet tall enough to create a proper little festive focal point.
WARM WHITE GLOW: Built-in warm white LEDs shine through the green branches to create a soft, cosy seasonal light. There is no need to add separate strings of lights, making this a simple way to brighten corners, smaller rooms and spaces beyond the main tree.
REALISTIC MINI TREE: Natural-look green branches give this artificial fir tree a fuller, more traditional Christmas finish than a basic light-up ornament. Use it as a stand-alone decoration or style it with garlands, baubles, pine cones and other festive accessories.
DETAILS: Supplied as 1 indoor InLit Sparkly Artificial Fir Tree, 40cm tall, with warm white LEDs and built-in timer. Place indoors only, position where extra festive glow is wanted, switch on and enjoy. Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included)
ABOUT US: At YouGarden, we believe that gardening is for everyone. Based in rural Lincolnshire, we have our own 11-acre nursery, meaning that we are in close contact with our plants, so that we can guarantee our plants will thrive because we've nurtured them ourselves.
Guarantee - 1 month

Comes pre-assembled
With stand

Product Introduction
This 12-pack dark green velvet Christmas ornament set is a great pick for family holiday decorating. Four pre-mixed styles save your matching time. The velvet touch is soft and the gold star details make them stand out. Unlike fragile glass baubles, these
 plastic ornaments are shatterproof, safe for children and pets. Built-in golden hangers let you hang them straight out of the box. The divided box makes tidy storage easy for reuse year after year.
Product Specifications

 Package contains 12 baubles, 3 of each design
 Ball diameter: 6 cm
 Material: Plastic shell, velvet flocking, glitter decoration, metal cap
 Colour: Dark forest green
 Storage: Grid kraft box

Application Scenarios
Family Christmas trees, living room decor, Christmas stockings, stair garlands, party table centrepieces, home holiday DIY decor, Christmas gift for family and friends.
Notes

 Indoor decoration only, not waterproof.
 Do not use chemical cleaner on the velvet surface.
 Check hanging caps regularly to make sure they are fastened well.
 If glitter sticks to clothes, brush off gently.
Forest Green Velvet Creates Warm Winter Aesthetic:Say goodbye to tacky bright decorations! The matte deep green velvet brings a quiet, cozy forest Christmas vibe. Fine gold star glitter shines softly without harsh reflection, ideal for aesthetic photo shooting.
Varied Textures for Rich Styling:Four unique shapes including glitter grid, glitter stripe, wavy texture and embossed geometric design. Mix and match freely to build depth and sense of hierarchy on your Christmas tree.
Lightweight & Easy to Arrange:Lightweight shatterproof plastic body allows you to hang and adjust positions conveniently. The golden hanging cap is firmly fixed and not easy to fall off during decoration.
Perfect for Aesthetic Scene Layout:Great for cottage-style home decor, fireplace vignettes, festive table styling, photo backdrops, wreath accents and slow-living scene decoration.
Delicate Box, Ready for Gifting:Neat grid kraft packaging looks elegant. It is a wonderful Christmas gift for friends who love vintage, subtle and low-key home decorations.

5075660367447.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Hanging Detail
The hanging detail provides a defined point for positioning or storage. Use a compatible support so the item can hang in its intended orientation.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red and White. Quantity: 15 piece set.
Shatter resistant plastic construction provides safe and durable festive decoration for your home.
Eye-catching glitter finish adds a textured, light-reflecting detail to enhance your Christmas tree display.
Includes 15 pieces in a coordinated red and white colour scheme for a classic seasonal aesthetic.
Lightweight design with hanging details allows for easy handling and versatile placement on branches.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 15 Christmas baubles
Hanger included

6 x Christmas Wooden Ornament Base Plates

EASY DIY STEPS

Open the package and check all tools and drill gems.

Match the symbol codes on the wooden ornament plate with the corresponding diamond color bags.

Apply a small amount of wax mud into the tip of the drill pen.

Pick up each resin gem using the pen and press it onto its matching symbol on the wooden plate.

Thread the included hanging cord through the top hole and hang your handmade wooden Christmas ornament.

Complete All-In-One Craft Kit: Comes with everything needed to start crafting immediately—6 wooden ornament bases, drill pen, sorting tray, sticky wax mud, hanging cords, and pre-sorted colored resin diamonds.
Pre-Drilled & Ready to Hang: Each wooden ornament features a pre-drilled top hole and includes natural jute twine/ribbons for easy hanging on Christmas trees, wreaths, and window hooks.
Relaxing & Beginner Friendly: Simple follow-by-number design makes this kit ideal for beginners, experienced crafters, family bonding time, and seasonal DIY projects.

9798173633347.sourceDescription: Fits Most Christmas Trees Securely: Measuring 12.6" H x 7.9" W, this Christmas angel tree topper is ideal for 8FT and taller Christmas trees. Weighing only 226g, the lightweight design with a sturdy cone base makes installation easy while keeping the angel upright and securely positioned on the tree top. Elegant Angel with Real Feather Wings: Our Christmas tree angel features delicate facial details and a graceful outfit, adding an elegant holiday touch to your décor. The white wings are crafted from natural feathers for a more realistic appearance, beautifully enhancing your Christmas tree decorations. Adjustable Light Mode & Brightness: Built with 15 warm LED lights, this lighted angel tree topper creates a cozy, eye-catching glow as the focal point of your Christmas tree. Choose from 8 lighting modes and 4 brightness levels to match different holiday settings. (Mode 8 offers steady-on lighting, ideal for those sensitive to flashing lights.) USB Powered for Convenient Use: The lighted Christmas tree topper is powered by USB for brighter and more stable lighting compared to battery-operated tree toppers. No frequent battery replacement needed for convenient holiday decorating. The included 3-meter extended power cord allows flexible placement to create a festive holiday scene. Remote Control & Timer Function: Easily control the power, brightness, and lighting modes using either the remote control or the inline USB controller. Built-in timer settings support 6H ON / 18H OFF automatic operation for energy-saving and hassle-free holiday lighting-no need to climb ladders repeatedly. Perfect for Multiple Decorating Scenes: More than just a Christmas tree topper, this lighted angel decoration is also perfect for decorating fireplaces, tabletops, shelves, living rooms, offices, Christmas parties, and holiday displays. Its elegant, glowing design adds warmth and festive charm to any indoor Christmas décor setup.

5059574911347.sourceDescription:
Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and aluminium construction give them a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Double Sided Design
The two sided design gives you a choice of usable surfaces or presentation. Turn the item to the side that suits the intended arrangement.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Aluminium. Colour: White. Stated size: 3 inch. Product weight: 0.29 kg. Quantity: 24 pack.
Double-sided design allows you to choose the best presentation side for your display.
Includes a hanging cord for easy attachment and secure positioning on your tree.
Pack of 24 aluminium ornaments provides ample quantity for full festive decoration.
White finish adds a defined, classic appearance to your Christmas display.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: Hanging Cord
Hanger included

Bring red foliage into your seasonal decorating with this pack of 4 artificial ficus garlands, each measuring 1.8m. Pointed leaf shapes branch along the garland, bringing an open leafy outline and a glittered surface to festive arrangements. The glitter finish adds a decorative accent to Christmas displays, while the red colour helps coordinate the arrangement with your chosen ribbons and ornaments. Lay a length along a mantel, arrange it around a banister or incorporate it into a festive window display. The artificial leaves can also form part of Christmas table centrepieces, wreath-making projects and indoor wedding decorations, allowing the same foliage style to appear in different areas. Plan each length around the space available and position your own accessories alongside it to complete the look. This option contains 4 separate garlands, allowing you to repeat the design across several locations or arrange individual lengths alongside one another. Combine the glittered foliage with plain decorations for contrasting texture, or use it within a wider festive colour theme for your home or party setting.

Decorative Leaf Design: Pointed leaf shapes branch along the garland, bringing an open leafy outline and a glittered surface to festive arrangements. The red colour can be used as the main accent or combined with other seasonal decorations, adding a leafy detail to indoor Christmas and party displays.
Mantel And Stair Decor: Arrange the 1.8m foliage length along a mantel, position it around a banister or use it within a Christmas window display. Plan the layout to suit your space, then add your own ribbons and ornaments to coordinate the garland with nearby festive decorations.
Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the red ficus foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.
Pack Size And Coverage: Contains 4 separate garlands, each with a 1.8m decorative length. Arrange the individual lengths across separate areas or alongside one another. Coordinate with your own ribbons and ornaments to carry the foliage theme through your indoor seasonal arrangement.

An L initial with a snowman hugging it, all in red and gold — the sort of decoration that looks like it belongs on a tree rather than a party bag.

The print quality is what lifts it: high definition onto acrylic, so the shapes have depth and shading instead of looking flat. Add in the small festive detailing — bells, snowflakes and so on — and it reads as something considered.

It's flat-cut, under four millimetres, so it won't twist about, and the metallic gold cord is pre-tied and ready. Being acrylic, it's entirely safe anywhere within reach, which means it can be hung where it'll actually be seen.

5056797098947.sourceDescription:
Create a dense, sparkling festive display with these 360 LED cluster lights from MySmartBuy. Blue and cool white LEDs are densely packed on a flexible silver pin wire for a rich, full effect. Wrap them around trees, bushes, garlands, fences and gardens. They are supplied with a 5m transparent lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights them for 6 hours and then switches them off for 18 hours, so they come on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Festive lights are among the most versatile decorations you can own. Use them to outline windows and doors, wrap trees and railings, or layer them with light up figures and wreaths to tie a whole display together. Versatile and easy to use, they are a quick way to transform your home and garden for the festive season, and can be brought out again year after year. At a glance: 360 LED cluster lights | Blue and cool white LEDs | flexible silver pin wire | 8 lighting modes | 5m transparent lead cable | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | outdoor use.

OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS DISPLAY : Trees, bushes, garlands, fences and gardens.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The brown finish and PVC construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display

5056713294347.sourceDescription:
Create an elegant winter display with this 6ft Christmas garland with lights. Realistic artificial pine and cypress-style foliage combines varied green tones, delicately frosted tips and clear faux ice beads for a natural-looking seasonal finish.

Approximately 1.8m long, the garland can be arranged across a fireplace mantel, along a staircase banister or over a hallway console. Its flexible design and trailing branch tips allow you to shape a relaxed display, while the faux ice beads add subtle sparkle among the greenery.

Warm white LED lighting creates a welcoming atmosphere. Switch to cool white whenever you prefer a crisper glow; both colours are included. Eight light modes offer steady, flashing and slow-fade effects in each colour, plus two colour-changing effects, controlled using the battery-pack button.

The automatic timer provides 6 hours on followed by 18 hours off, repeating daily while enabled. Requires 3 AA batteries, not included.

Suitable for indoor and outdoor display. Choose a sheltered position for prolonged outdoor use, keep the battery compartment securely closed and never submerge the battery pack in water. Gently arrange the foliage before displaying.

Includes one garland, approximately 6ft (1.8m) long.
Guarantee - 1 year

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Material: Bamboo. Product measurements: length 15 cm, width 15 cm, height 2 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Crafted from natural bamboo for an eco-friendly festive touch.
Compact 15cm design adds detail without overwhelming your display.
Versatile ornament suitable for coordinating with existing decor themes.
Single item pack allows flexible arrangement within your Christmas setup.

5059574924347.sourceDescription:
Light Up Snowman
This light up snowman adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Product measurements: length 22 cm, width 11 cm, height 8 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive light-up snowman design adds a charming focal point to your Christmas display.
Compact dimensions of 22cm x 11cm x 8cm make it ideal for small spaces and shelves.
Versatile decoration suitable for coordinating with existing room colour and texture schemes.
Practical single-item packaging ensures easy placement and flexible arrangement options.
Guarantee - 1 month
Power source: Battery-powered
Suitable for Indoor & outdoor use
Christmas decoration, festive lighting
